# Prodicus of Ceos

*465 BCE – 395 BCE · Greek*

A teacher famous for the exact distinction of synonyms, whose lessons [Socrates](../philosophers/socrates.md) says he attended. He is the author of the fable of Heracles at the crossroads, choosing between Vice and Virtue, and of an account of the gods as the deification of things useful to humans.
